pick_device.title: Device
pick_device.description: The device this Bestiarium device is on. Pick another one when the appliance moved to a new device in Home Assistant (for example from SmartThings to Matter): priorities, settings and the learned consumption stay, the response time is learned anew.

configure_priorities.title: Configure Load Priorities
configure_priorities.description: Set load priorities for each mode. Per-mode priorities are optional and will use the default priority if not specified. 0 = always off, 9999 = always on.

data.overload_first_queue: Turn off in first queue during overload
data.thermostat_driven: Switched on by its own thermostat

data_description.overload_first_queue: When enabled, this device is turned off in the first wave when overload protection is activated; otherwise it is turned off only if overload persists after 5 seconds.
data_description.thermostat_driven: When enabled, the balancer never turns this device on; it only turns it off by priority (red zone, overload, a mode with priority 0). Its own thermostat turns it back on.

init.title: Balancer control
init.description: How the balancer controls this device. Changes apply at once.

data.unstable_dropouts_per_hour: Dropouts an hour for an unstable connection

data_description.estimated_power_w: What the device draws when on, if you know it; 0 means not set. It counts until the device has 3 real runs
data_description.reset_power_memory: Forget the device's runs; its history is not imported again
data_description.attempts: Failed commands in a row after which the balancer defers the device and goes on with the next one
data_description.defer_minutes: How long a device that does not respond waits before it is tried again
data_description.tolerance_seconds: A switch or power sensor gone for less than this is a short dropout, not a problem
data_description.hysteresis_seconds: A problem ends only after the device has worked this long without a dropout
data_description.unstable_dropouts_per_hour: This many short dropouts in an hour make the connection unstable

data.default_response_seconds: Response time of a new device, seconds
data.red_max_wait_seconds: Longest wait in the red zone, seconds

data_description.default_response_seconds: Used until the device has answered commands; then its own response time counts
data_description.response_margin: An attempt fails only after the device's longest response time times this
data_description.red_max_wait_seconds: In the red zone the balancer waits for a device at most this long before it turns off the next one

no_load_zones.description: Bestiarium Devices does not turn devices on or off: Bestiarium Mode has no load zones. Set its AC load limits (Settings → Devices & services → Bestiarium Mode → Reconfigure → Configure AC load limits). Balancing starts as soon as the zones appear, without a restart.
